title: VerifierBench: Benchmarking the Generation of Executable Verifiers for LLM Agents
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce VerifierBench, a benchmark of 222 tasks from six agent benchmarks spanning tool-call, state-based, and code verification, with 4,993 hidden test cases that include alternative valid solutions and attacks; Verifier4Verifier (V4V), a six-check audit, screens its source verifiers and test suites.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Agents need reliable ways to validate their outputs, both when completing tasks and when filtering synthetic training data.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across 19 models in a common agent harness, normalized balanced accuracy ranges from 10.6 to 62.1, with generated verifiers consistently rejecting invalid solutions more reliably than they accept valid ones.
